reviews.title: Great price for 1080p gaming
reviews.comment: Got this for a second monitor amazing price got it around like $100ish. Very good picture quality, love the different settings they have on the monitor you can find your fit for whatever you want to use it for and they high refresh rate makes this super fun to play on definitely on a competitive level. Pretty light weight of a monitor but still has that quality/ durability feel to it.
reviews.author: Nathan

reviews.title: 10/10 Gaming monitor
reviews.comment: Beta budget/competitive monitor right now. The darker colors look way darker than any monitor I’ve used and the smooth frames are so responsive. Also the quality of the stand was very good along with the many different customizable  picture settings.
reviews.author: Josh White

reviews.title: Monitor could do better
reviews.comment: Lowkey looks terrible out the box spent like 2hrs trying to get it looking good but it looks decent after optimizing settings. Image quality isn’t the best but, it’s pretty smooth and good for games. Overall, the monitor is a good budget option but, you’re sacrificing a ton of image quality and coloring for a 300hz monitor that needs to be overclocked to 310hz. Viewing angles are pretty bad too needs to be viewed straight on or it will look off. If your broke as a joke get this but if you have an extra cash laying around I’d personally say stay away. TLDR; Looks bad out the box can be calibrated to look better and is good for gaming but there are better options out there. Great performance for the price though.
reviews.author: Him
